text:
elaine: Quick sync — post-launch checklist for the benchmark narrative + webinar funnel. Need decisions on redirects, canonical signals, and a tiny schema snippet for the benchmark page. I’ll drop what I think below.

sam: 👍 priorities? I can spin up the funnel tracking and set up UTM templates.

elaine: Priority order: 1) redirect cleanup so old trial landing pages map to canonical benchmark page, 2) internal link tweaks from product docs -> benchmark, 3) small JSON-LD to mark benchmark results, 4) CTA wiring for webinar signups (inbound routing).

marta: For redirects — suggest 301 for old canonical variants, but keep 302 for A/B test variants we might revisit this week. Anyone have the list of old slugs?

elaine: I exported a CSV of 12 old slugs in the launch doc. Putting one example here: `/benchmarks/latency-v1` -> `/benchmarks/latency-2026`

elaine: Proposed Nginx rule (example):
```
location ~ ^/benchmarks/(latency|throughput)-v[0-9]+$ {
  return 301 https://redwood.inference/benchmarks/latency-2026;
}
```

sam: Nice. We should also add a canonical meta tag on the new page for any querystring variants. I'll add a snippet to the markup.

david: On schema — recommend `Article` with an additional `hasPart` for each benchmark section. Small JSON-LD draft: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Inference cost & latency benchmark (June 2026)","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"hasPart":[{"@type":"WebPageElement","name":"GPU throughput results"},{"@type":"WebPageElement","name":"Quantization comparisons"}]}
```

marta: That should help rich results for the benchmark query set. Also add `mainEntity` linking to the demo notebook on GitHub.

elaine: Good call. For inbound routing — webinar signups should go to HubSpot form ID `hs_7765`. Sam, can you confirm redirect from `/benchmarks/signup` -> externally to the HubSpot embed? We need server-side 302 so UTM persists.

sam: Confirmed. I’ll add the `/benchmarks/signup` path to the site router and attach utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=benchmark_q2.

seo-bot: SEO alert: Found 3 pages with duplicate title tags referencing old model names. Recommend title update + 301s as listed by @elaine.

elaine: Thanks bot. David, can you update the canonical and JSON-LD before EOD? Marta — can you own the internal link anchor text sweep (product docs -> benchmark) and list the changed pages here?

marta: On it. I’ll replace vague anchors like "learn more" with "inference benchmark" and push a PR with 8 edits.

david: Will update canonical and JSON-LD now. Quick question: do we need `speakable` or any FAQ schema?

elaine: Not for this page — focus on `Article` + `hasPart` + `mainEntity`. We might add FAQ for the webinar landing next week.

sam: Routing note — inbound leads from webinar registration: create a HubSpot list that tags `source:benchmark_launch` and triggers the webinar nurture sequence. I’ll wire that and share the list ID.

marta: One more thing — internal linking audit flag: ensure no orphaned benchmark pages. I’ll run Screaming Frog and drop a short report in the doc by 11:30 PT.

elaine: Perfect. Action items:
- sam: add signup router + utm rules + share list ID
- david: canonical tag + JSON-LD commit
- marta: anchor text sweep + Screaming Frog report
- elaine: publish redirect CSV and merge 301s (I’ll own the deploy)

elaine: Timeline: have everything staged by EOD tomorrow and live by Thursday morning PST.

sam: Got it. Will ping once HubSpot wiring complete. :rocket:

david: PR opened for JSON-LD + canonical. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/421

marta: Report uploaded to the launch doc. No orphan pages, 2 low-priority broken internal links fixed.

elaine: Awesome. If anything blocks, ping this thread. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
